EdgeR Function Testing

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(RNAseqQC)
```

```{r}
source("../R/edgeR_diffexp.R")

cnt_matrix <- readr::read_tsv("./test_data/count_matrix.tsv")

colnames(cnt_matrix) <- sub("\\.bam$", "", colnames(cnt_matrix))

colnames(cnt_matrix)[[1]] <- "GeneID"

cnt_matrix <- cnt_matrix %>% tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "GeneID") %>% as.matrix()

#making fake meta_data
meta_data <- tibble(sample_name = colnames(cnt_matrix), condition = c("CONTROL", "CONTROL", "DISEASE", "DISEASE")) 
meta_data <- meta_data %>% tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "sample_name")

# Unflitered Counts Saved to a DeSeqDataSet (dds object)
fake_ds1 <- make_dds(counts = cnt_matrix, metadata = meta_data, ah_record = "AH116291")
#renaming counts to raw counts
assayNames(fake_ds1)[1] <- "counts"

#variance stabilized Raw counts
# since our test data set is ver small we have to use a small nsub varibale
nsb = sum(rowMeans(counts(fake_ds1)) > 5)

assays(fake_ds1)[[2]] <- vst(fake_ds1@assays@data$counts, nsub = nsb)
assayNames(fake_ds1)[2] <- "var_stable"
#log_transformed (log normalized counts)
assays(fake_ds1)[[3]] <- log10(fake_ds1@assays@data$counts + 1)
assayNames(fake_ds1)[3] <- "log_counts"

#saving the DDS object as an rd object
saveRDS(fake_ds1, "./test_data/fake_dds.rds")
```

```{r}
library(testthat)
source("../R/edgeR_diffexp.R")


dds_object <- fake_ds1
#Add the condition column name
condition_col = "condition"
#set a refreence group name
ref_group_name = "CONTROL"


#Performs inital differential expression on your DDS Object's raw counts dataframe
# The use give the condition column from the metadata to make the test parameters
# and the control group

#"correct instance"
results_dds1 <- edgeR_diffexp(dds_object, 
                              condition_col,  
                              ref_group_name,
                              init_pval_cutoff = 2,
                              adjust.method = "bonferroni")
```

Testing for Input Errors

Testing for valid:

Invalid Object input,

condition column input,

ref_group_name,

valid pvalue adjust.method

```{r}
library(testthat)

#Input esting
test_that(
  "pvalue_input validations",{
    
    invalid_pvalues <- c(NA, "0.05")
    
    for (i in invalid_pvalues){
    # pvalue check
    expect_error(
      edgeR_diffexp(
        dds_object = dds_object,
        condition_col = condition_col,
        ref_group_name = ref_group_name,
        init_pval_cutoff = i
      )
    )}#end of loop
    
  })#end of test_that function

test_that(
  #condition column test
  "expect error for failed column name", {
  expect_error(
    edgeR_diffexp(
      dds_object = dds_object,
      condition_col = "fake_column",
      ref_group_name = ref_group_name,
      init_pval_cutoff = 0.5,
      adjust.method = "bonferroni"
    ) 
  )# end of internal test
})


#expecting invalid p.adjust method
test_that(
  "valid p.adjust methods",{
    valid_p.adjust_method <- c("bonferroni","BH")
    for(i in valid_p.adjust_method)
      expect_no_error(
        edgeR_diffexp(
          dds_object = dds_object,
          condition_col = condition_col,
          ref_group_name = ref_group_name,
          init_pval_cutoff = 0.5,
          adjust.method = i
        ) 
      )
  })
```

```{r}
test_that("test_1",{expect_error()}, "test_2",{expect_no_error()})
```
